name: dotnet-msix
Packages MSIX apps: creation, signing, Store submission, App Installer sideload, auto-update. .NET desktop MSIX pipeline for csproj (`WindowsPackageType`) and WAP projects, certificate signing (self-signed for development, trusted CA for production, Microsoft Store signing), distribution channels (Microsoft Store submission, App Installer sideloading, enterprise deployment via SCCM/Intune), auto-update configuration (App Installer XML, version checking, differential updates), MSIX bundle format for multi-architecture (`.msixbundle`), and CI/CD MSIX build steps.
**Version assumptions:** Windows App SDK 1.6+ (current stable). Windows 10 build 19041+ minimum for MSIX with Windows App SDK. Windows 10 build 1709+ for App Installer auto-update protocol. .NET 8.0+ baseline.
WinUI 3 project setup and MSIX vs unpackaged comparison -- see [skill:dotnet-winui]
